sourceRefs.locator: Paragraphs around notes 84–88. Athalaric, his minority and his mother Amalasuentha’s regency, the accession letters and the promised continuation of rights.

note.de: Nach dem Tod Theoderichs folgte der minderjährige Athalarich. Seine Mutter Amalasuntha regierte für ihn und suchte in Schreiben an das Reich die Unterstützung der bisherigen Amtsträger und des Senats.
note.en: After Theoderic’s death his young grandson Athalaric succeeded. His mother Amalasuntha governed for him and sought the support of existing officials and the Senate through the letters announcing his accession.
